annotations.title: Find a salon that books through Timio

description: Find hair salons, barbershops, nail salons, brow and lash studios and beauty clinics that take online bookings through Timio, in Brazil, Ireland, the United States and Spain. Search by city or neighborhood, by the business name, or by service (for example 'gel nails', 'corte masculino', 'manicura'). Returns each business with its location, a few services and its booking link.

location.description: City or neighborhood, for example 'Pinheiros, São Paulo', 'Dublin' or 'Madrid'.
